title: fix(cli): os create plugin ships a starter test, so a fresh scaffold's npm test passes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu4GrD7D5BC5v5WW4ryVhyCV)_

Fixes #25175
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This is the `os create plugin` half of #25175, the half left after #25196 landed the `os init -t plugin` half (`9c431bad3`). With it, both plugin scaffolds pass their own `npm test` out of the box.

## What changes

A project made by `os create plugin NAME` declared `"test": "vitest"` and contained no test file, so its first `npm test` exited 1 with `No test files found, exiting with code 1`. The `plugin` template in `packages/cli/src/commands/create.ts` (both placements) now:

- writes **`src/index.test.ts`**, a starter test that runs the checks the kernel runs on a plugin when it loads one, before any of its code: a `name`, an `init` function (the loader's `validatePluginStructure`), and the protocol's `PluginSchema` (`assertPluginContract`), through `@objectstack/spec/kernel`, which the manifest already declares. Its header links the `@objectstack/verify` harness ("A runtime plugin" on `protocol/kernel/plugin-spec`) for tests that need a booted kernel;
- writes **`tsconfig.build.json`**: `extends: './tsconfig.json'`, `exclude: ['dist', 'node_modules', 'src/**/*.test.ts']`;
- emits `build: 'tsc -p tsconfig.build.json'`, `dev: 'tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch'` and `test: 'vitest run'` (one pass that exits, as `os init` emits). `typecheck` stays `tsc --noEmit`, on `tsconfig.json`.

The three public pages whose printed file tree `create-plugin-docs-parity.test.ts` holds equal to the emitted file set gain one line per new file: `content/docs/plugins/index.mdx`, `content/docs/protocol/kernel/index.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/kernel/plugin-spec.mdx` (its CLI transcript, in emission order).

Changeset: `.changeset/25175-create-plugin-scaffold-test.md` (`@objectstack/cli` patch), with the one-line fix for a project scaffolded by an earlier release.

## The route, and why it is honest

The card allows a starter test or a script that does not fail on an empty suite. This takes the starter test. The previous dev's four measured placements (report on #25175) were re-measured on this branch:

| placement | `npm test` | after `npm run build` | `typecheck` covers the test |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| S1 `src/index.test.ts`, build stays `tsc` | 1 file | `dist/index.test.js` + `.d.ts` emitted, the package ships its tests, and vitest collects the compiled copy too | yes |
| **S2 (this PR)** `src/index.test.ts` + `tsconfig.build.json` | 1 file | `dist/` = `index.js`, `index.d.ts`; still 1 file | yes: a planted type error fails `typecheck` |
| S3 `test/` outside `rootDir: 'src'` | 1 file | clean | no (TS6059 if included) |
| S4 `vitest run --passWithNoTests` | exit 0, nothing ran | | |

S2 is the only row that keeps `dist/` clean without hiding the test from the type checker. The pin below holds each of those properties, and the ablation shows each one can go red.

The test is not a placeholder: emitted with `init` renamed to `start`, it fails `expected 'undefined' to be 'function'`; emitted with `version: 'v0.1.0'`, `PluginSchema` refuses it (ablation legs E and F).

## Measured end to end (npm 10.9.4, registry `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0, vitest 4.1.12, typescript 5.9.3)

`os create plugin e2e-pkg` from this branch's built CLI, outside the repository, then `npx -y npm@10 install`:

| step | exit | reading |
|:---|:---:|:---|
| `npm test` | 0 | `Test Files  1 passed (1)`, `Tests  1 passed (1)` |
| `npm run build` | 0 | `dist/` = `index.d.ts`, `index.js` |
| `npm test` after the build | 0 | `Test Files  1 passed (1)` |
| `npm run typecheck` | 0 | |
| `npm test` with `src/index.test.ts` removed | 1 | `No test files found, exiting with code 1` |
| baseline: `main`'s `os create plugin`, `npm test` | 1 | `No test files found, exiting with code 1` |

## The pin, and its ablation

`packages/cli/test/scaffold-test-script-passes.test.ts` (`unit` tier) gains an `os create` block beside the `os init` one, sharing its sandbox (OS temp dir, no ancestor runner config, one symlink per declared dependency). Roster derived from `create`'s `templates` (default placement) whose manifest declares `test`:

- the emitted `test` script exits 0 and the files that ran are exactly the shipped test files;
- after the emitted `build` script, `dist/` holds `index.js` and no `*.test.*`, and `test` still runs exactly the shipped files;
- the emitted `typecheck` passes, and fails once a type error is planted in the starter test;
- control: the same project without its test files fails `test`.

Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `create.ts` (imported by relative source specifier, no `dist/` on the path), each leg restored with `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty:

| leg | mutation | result |
|:---|:---|:---|
| A | `build: 'tsc'` (S1) | red: `the build compiled the starter test into dist/: expected [ 'index.test.d.ts', 'index.test.js' ] to deeply equal []` |
| B | `tsconfig.build.json` without the test exclude | red: same case, same reading |
| C | `typecheck: 'tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit'` (test outside the checked program) | red: `a type error in the starter test passed typecheck` |
| D | starter test emitted as `src/index.spec-off.ts` | red: 3 cases (no test file emitted; `vitest run` finds none) |
| E | emitted plugin's `init` renamed to `start` | red: `expected 'undefined' to be 'function'` |
| F | emitted plugin's version `v0.1.0` | red: `PluginSchema` issue list not empty |

## Verification (head `2aed9ddea`, after merging `origin/main` `03de83bf`; the two incoming commits touch none of these files)

- New pin + `create-plugin-docs-parity` + `create`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 32 passed (32)`.
- `@objectstack/cli` `unit` tier, full (`vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`): `Test Files 324 passed (324)`, `Tests 4784 passed (4784)`. The `integration` tier is declared to CI: the diff touches no spawn entry and no integration-tier file.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck` OK (no new signature). ESLint on the two changed TS files: clean.
- Gates: all 97 commands from `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, plus `check:template-version-sync` and `check:scaffold-emission-policy`, exit 0. Four first exited 3 on prerequisites outside this diff (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs a pinned commit a shallow clone lacks; `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` read `dist/` of packages outside the CLI closure) and exit 0 after `git fetch` of that commit and a full `pnpm build`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `--in-repo` placement** gets the same three changes; its sandbox run is not pinned, because its `tsconfig.json` extends this monorepo's root config and means nothing outside it. Its emission is covered by `create.test.ts` and the docs-parity pin reads the default placement only, as before.
- **"Next steps"** printed by `os create` still say `pnpm install` / `pnpm build`; it does not mention `pnpm test`. Unchanged here, to keep the plugin-spec transcript the only docs edit beyond the listings.
- **Process:** this card ran as a project card thread on the harness-pinned branch `claude/project-thread-4oxk47`, not `claude/issue-25175-*`; the claim on #25175 records that.
